name: Trakzee
description: Flagship enterprise fleet management software designed for live GPS tracking, fuel theft detection, route optimization, and driver safety.
highlights: Real-time GPS vehicle tracking with live telemetry, speed, and health diagnostics
Sensor-integrated fuel monitoring system detecting refilling, draining, and theft
AI route optimization analyzing traffic and restrictions to minimize transit costs
Driver behavior monitoring with violation scoring, ADAS/DMS alerts, and maintenance reminders

name: Trakzee Mini
description: Simplified personal vehicle tracking platform tailored for agile car monitoring, geofence security, and real-time ignition status.
highlights: Real-time vehicle location tracking with ignition on/off and battery status
Customizable virtual geofencing with instant boundary breach push notifications
Historical trip playback with speed analytics, idle duration, and mileage logs
Remote engine immobilization command support for anti-theft security

name: LogyTrak
description: Supply chain and logistics management software built for consignment tracking, dynamic route dispatch, and turnaround efficiency.
highlights: End-to-end consignment and freight tracking with milestone transit checkpoints
Automated multi-stop route optimization and dynamic carrier dispatching
Electronic Proof of Delivery (e-POD) with OTP verification and digital signatures
Detention, demurrage, and transporter performance analytics

name: Petzee
description: Intelligent pet tracking and safety platform designed to monitor real-time location, activity levels, and safe perimeter zones.
highlights: Sub-second live GPS location tracking with satellite map overlay
Virtual safe perimeter geofencing with instant escape and return alerts
Daily activity goal monitoring, resting periods, and wellness trends
Pet group management and multi-user guardian access via mobile app

name: Elexee
description: Smart electric vehicle (EV) management software optimizing battery health, charging logistics, and regenerative driving range.
highlights: Real-time State of Charge (SOC), cell voltage, and temperature diagnostics
Charging station route planning with off-peak charging automation
Dynamic range estimation addressing range anxiety based on driving patterns
CAN-bus integration for motor efficiency and energy consumption analytics

name: TaskEye
description: Workforce and field task management software designed to automate employee attendance, task dispatch, and proof of work.
highlights: Real-time GPS attendance marking with geofenced site check-in verification
Dynamic task dispatching with real-time status, photos, and digital sign-offs
Automated travel mileage calculation for field expense reimbursements
Integrated leave management system and manager live workforce map view

name: SmartWaste
description: IoT-driven waste collection system optimizing municipal cleanup through smart fill-level sensors and dynamic garbage truck routing.
highlights: Ultrasonic IoT bin sensor monitoring with automated fullness threshold alerts
Dynamic AI collection routing targeting only bins that require emptying
RFID pickup verification with driver completion and timestamp logging
Municipal fuel savings, operational efficiency, and carbon reduction reporting

name: SmartTranzit
description: Public transportation management software designed to automate passenger counting, bus scheduling, and route adherence.
highlights: Overhead camera Automated Passenger Counting (APC) for real-time bus occupancy
Dynamic timetable scheduling with headway management and bus bunching alerts
Integration with Passenger Information Display Systems (PIDS) and commuter apps
Automated Fare Collection (AFC) verification and transit KPI analytics

name: Employee Transportation
description: Enterprise employee transport management system (ETMS) ensuring automated shift rostering, real-time tracking, and women's safety.
highlights: Intelligent shift rostering with automated pickup/drop route clustering
Real-time cab tracking with employee boarding OTP and safe drop confirmation
Dedicated women safety protocols with escort guard tracking and route monitoring
In-app SOS panic button connected 24/7 to the corporate command center

name: SmartBus
description: School bus tracking and student safety platform providing parents and schools with live GPS tracking, RFID boarding, and instant ETA.
highlights: Live school bus tracking on parent mobile app with real-time ETA countdown
Student RFID card tap boarding and deboarding confirmation with guardian alerts
Automated stop geofencing and multi-bus school route optimization
Driver behavior monitoring, speed governance, and emergency SOS alerts

name: Gridzee
description: Real-time indoor location system (RTLS) for tracking warehouse assets, forklifts, equipment, and workforce safety.
highlights: Sub-meter BLE beacons and Ultra-Wideband (UWB) indoor positioning accuracy
Multi-floor 2.5D building mapping with asset utilization heatmaps
Restricted zone geofencing with unauthorized entry and collision alarms
Lone-worker man-down alarms and emergency evacuation muster counts
